howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会添加 WhatsApp 渠道：复制适配器、注册、安装依赖、跑构建和测试。机器人即可用官方 Meta API 收发 WhatsApp 消息，需要你提供令牌等凭据。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 添加 WhatsApp 渠道（如“接入 WhatsApp”），或在 /setup 流程中需要加渠道时触发。

say.text: 帮我把机器人接入 WhatsApp
say.note: 开始添加渠道，会问你凭据。

say.text: 添加 WhatsApp Cloud API 渠道
say.note: 会注册渠道并安装依赖。

say.text: 配置 WhatsApp 的 webhook 和验证令牌
say.note: 引导你完成 Meta 后台设置。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude adds the WhatsApp Cloud channel: copies the adapter, registers it, installs a pinned dependency, runs build/test. The bot can then exchange WhatsApp messages via the official Meta API with your credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a WhatsApp channel, or during the /setup flow when a channel is needed.

say_en.note: Starts the skill and asks for credentials.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp Cloud API channel
say_en.note: Registers the channel and installs dependencies.

say_en.text: Set up WhatsApp webhook and verify token
